abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) frequently recurs after curative-intent resection, and conventional imaging and CA19-9 have limited sensitivity for detecting molecular residual disease (MRD). Tumor-informed circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) may identify postoperative MRD, although the evidence is limited and heterogeneous.
METHODS: PubMed, Scopus, and Embase were searched from inception to July 9, 2026, following PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Eligible studies compared postoperative tumor-informed ctDNA-positive and ctDNA-negative patients after curative-intent treatment of pancreatic cancer for recurrence, survival, or lead time outcomes. Random-effects models were used to pool risk ratios (RRs) and hazard ratios (HRs). Heterogeneity, leave-one-out sensitivity, prespecified subgroups, ROBINS-I risk of bias, and GRADE certainty were assessed.
RESULTS: Five observational cohorts contributed 237 patients to the radiological recurrence comparison (84 ctDNA-positive and 153 ctDNA-negative). Postoperative ctDNA positivity was associated with increased radiological recurrence (RR 2.50; 95% CI 1.90-3.28; I²=20%), poorer disease-free survival (HR 8.11; 95% CI 3.51-18.73; I²=45%), and poorer overall survival (HR 5.15; 95% CI 2.67-9.94; I²=0%). The direction of the associations persisted in the reported leave-one-out assessments. Recurrence risk was higher in both the early-MRD/landmark and surveillance subgroups, with no statistically significant subgroup difference (P = 0.17).
CONCLUSION: Postoperative tumor-informed ctDNA positivity was associated with an increased recurrence risk and inferior survival after curative-intent PDAC treatment, although a negative result did not reliably exclude residual disease. Prospective interventional studies are needed before ctDNA-guided surveillance or treatment modifications can be recommended for routine practice.
key_points_ko: 수술 후 ctDNA 양성은 방사선학적 재발 위험 증가와 관련이 있었습니다 (위험비 RR 2.50).
수술 후 ctDNA 양성 환자는 무병 생존기간(DFS)이 불리했습니다 (위험비 HR 8.11).
수술 후 ctDNA 양성 환자는 전체 생존기간(OS)이 불리했습니다 (위험비 HR 5.15).
총 5개의 관찰 코호트에서 237명의 환자 데이터가 분석에 포함되었습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 근치적 목적의 수술을 받은 췌장관선암(PDAC) 환자를 대상으로 수술 후 종양 맞춤형 순환 종양 DNA(ctDNA) 양성 여부가 재발 및 생존에 미치는 영향을 평가한 체계적 문헌고찰 및 메타분석입니다. 5개의 관찰 코호트에서 총 237명의 환자가 포함되었습니다. 분석 결과, 수술 후 ctDNA 양성은 방사선학적 재발 위험 증가, 무병 생존기간(DFS) 악화, 그리고 전체 생존기간(OS) 악화와 유의하게 연관되었습니다. 저자들은 ctDNA가 예후 예측에 유용하지만, ctDNA 기반 감시나 치료 변경을 표준 진료로 권장하기 위해서는 전향적 중재 연구가 추가로 필요하다고 결론지었습니다.
title: Postoperative Tumor-Informed Circulating Tumor DNA Status for Molecular Residual Disease Detection After Curative-Intent Resection of Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
title_ko: 근치적 절제술을 받은 췌장관선암 환자에서 수술 후 종양 맞춤형 순환 종양 DNA(ctDNA) 상태를 이용한 분자적 잔류 질환 검출: 체계적 문헌고찰 및 메타분석
